description:
FILED s398 (Fable, #153 FOLD chunk 3 review probes; occurs in NO population — filler).  PRE-EXISTING: identical on main (13bcef4).

PROBED vs perl 5.40.3 (scratchpad probes/can.pl):
    sub x { 42 }
    __PACKAGE__->can("main::x")   perl: true    PCL: false
    __PACKAGE__->can("x")         perl: true    PCL: true
    main->can("main::x")          perl: true    PCL: false

perl: UNIVERSAL::can looks the name up with gv_fetchmethod, which accepts a fully-qualified name (`Pkg::name`) and resolves it directly in that package (also `SUPER::name`), returning the code ref.  PCL's runtime can only tries the invocant's MRO with the literal string as the method name.

FIX SHAPE: in the runtime `can` (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp, the UNIVERSAL::can implementation), when the name contains `::`, split off the package and look the sub up there directly (the same lookup a qualified method CALL `$o->Pkg::name` uses — reuse that resolver, CLAUDE.md 11), falling back to the MRO walk only for unqualified names.  Guard row in a Pl/t OO test (probe vs perl first).  BAR: gate; runtime change → full sweep (s377 rule).
subject: `->can("Pkg::name")` with a QUALIFIED method name returns false (perl resolves it)
